notes.XDspActivate: type 1 convolution (XDefiant) on host; types 2 and 3 return E_NOTIMPL, no title uses them

notes.D3D12XboxCreateDevice: Xbox One params (0x28 bytes) checked for null, then handed to the emulator's d3d12_xs.dll (Scarlett vtable wrapper, PC slots 0-43 only verified for Xbox One); host D3D12CreateDevice if d3d12_xs is absent
notes.D3D12XboxSetProcessDebugFlags: stores flags & 0x81f00001 like the console runtime
notes.D3D12XboxUnloadDriverModule: void like the console; console FreeLibrary()s its xgs user-mode driver only when one is loaded, this runtime never loads one
notes.D3DAllocateGraphicsMemory: returns E_NOTIMPL exactly like the console d3d12_x.dll (body is mov eax,0x80004001)
notes.D3DConfigureVirtualMemory: console rules: flags & ~5 -> E_INVALIDARG, >0x21 page-table pages -> debug string + E_INVALIDARG; outputs cleared, XMem config {pages<<22, flag 4 ? 0 : 0xa00000}, returns HRESULT_FROM_NT(STATUS_SUCCESS)
notes.D3DFlushEntireCpuCache: full fence + FlushProcessWriteBuffers: PC CPU-visible heaps are coherent, so draining every core's store buffer is the visible effect of the console cache flush
notes.D3DFreeGraphicsMemory: returns E_NOTIMPL exactly like the console d3d12_x.dll
notes.D3DMapEsramMemory: flags 1/3 only (else E_FAIL, as console); one 32 MiB ESRAM section, each page-list entry maps that 64 KiB ESRAM page at VA+i*64K, so pages alias across VAs and keep contents across remaps; a caller reservation around the range is kept

notes.D3D12ZeroMemoryX: console validation (16-byte aligned ranges, scratch >= 64 KiB command / 256 B fence); flags bit 0 or CPU VAs >= 1 TiB zeroed by CPU, GPU VAs zeroed by a copy-queue fill on the owning resource's device, DMA packets written to the caller's command scratch
notes.GetFrameBufferPreserveMemorySizeBytes: returns the size recorded by D3D12ConfigureVirtualMemoryX
notes.PixGetPixieEntryPoints: console hands out ~32 PIX counter callbacks that are IOCTLs (0x7900c1xx) into the Xbox graphics kernel driver; no counter backend in the emulator yet
notes.D3D10CreateBlob: host d3dcompiler_47.dll D3DCreateBlob (console calls the xgs12 UMDCreateBlob, same ID3DBlob object)
notes.D3D12ConfigureVirtualMemoryX: console flag/page-table checks, XMem graphics configuration registered
notes.D3D12CreateRootSignatureDeserializer: host d3d12.dll (console calls xgs12 UMDCreateRootSignatureDeserializer, same interface)
notes.D3D12UploadCustomMicrocodeX: console validates 7 pointer/size arguments then uploads CP microcode through IOCTL 0x7900c223; no GPU microcode engine to load it into on PC
notes.D3D12XboxCreateDevice: host D3D12 device wrapped in the Scarlett vtable layer
notes.D3D12XboxEnableMemoryProfiling: console IOCTL 0x7900c1cc to the graphics kernel driver with three arguments; kernel-side profiler not modelled
notes.D3D12XboxUnloadDriverModule: void; no xgs12 user-mode driver is loaded by this runtime
notes.D3DFlushEntireCpuCache: full fence + FlushProcessWriteBuffers: PC CPU-visible heaps are coherent, so draining every core's store buffer is the visible effect of the console cache flush
notes.InternalDriverCallX: console tail-calls xgs12 UMDInternalDriverCallX (codes 1/2 edit xgs12-internal descriptor and allocation objects); E_NOINTERFACE until that driver is loaded, and the emulator device has no xgs12 object layout

notes.DxcCreateInstance: official DXC 1.9.2609 (Microsoft-signed dxcompiler.dll + dxil.dll): next to dxcompiler_x, TOMBOX_DXC_DIR, or emulator third_party/dxc; compiles SM 6.0 HLSL to signed DXIL
